antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 635nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in keratinocyte if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Frequency sweep: 447->370->306 THz descending scan, 10^-13s per step, 5 cycles targeting NO_synthase in keratinocyte. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows NO modulation at 635nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial complex_I_NADH activation.
